note: Create via System > Lookup Tables, or POST these to the API in order. The .mmdb paths are where Graylog's own GeoIP processor expects them; adjust to your install. database_type MUST match the file: a Country or ASN database declared as MAXMIND_CITY loads without complaint and returns null for every key.

lookup_tables.title: GeoIP country
lookup_tables.name: geoip-country
lookup_tables.description: IP to ISO country code. Used by o365 masked ip geolocation

lookup_tables.title: GeoIP ASN
lookup_tables.name: geoip-asn
lookup_tables.description: IP to AS number (single value) and organisation. Used by o365 mail access source network
